verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a documented Copilot CLI (github-copilot-probe-4) that lets users script/drive Copilot from the terminal, and MCP support lets Copilot consume external servers, but there is no evidence of a documented public REST/GraphQL API specifically for driving Copilot programmatically — probes for openapi/swagger specs at docs.github.com all 404 (github-copilot-probe-3). Missing for 10: an official Copilot-specific API reference (REST/GraphQL/SDK), authentication docs for that API, and independent confirmation of programmatic use beyond the CLI.
